text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and the others visited Oedo during their school trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}たちは、
修学旅行でオーエドを訪れていた。

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Shogun! It was amazing, the Oedo Ninja Art Museum♪ Ninjas are like wizards from a different land! Shubabababa♪♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ショーグン！　
サイコーでしたネ、
オーエド忍術博物館♪
ニンジャは
まさに
トーゴクの魔法使いデース！
シュババババッ♪

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Look, Onii-chan! I made a statue of you in the Sugar Lucky Happy Experience! Huh? Sugakaki-yaki experience? Sugar Lucky Happy Experience... sounds similar!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見てくださいお兄ちゃん！
シュガーラッキーハッピー体験で
お兄ちゃんの置物作りましたよ！
え？　
シガラキ焼体験？　
シュガーラッキーハッピー体験……
似てる！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Kusu kusu, look at this, my dear. They've engraved our names on wooden swords.
text_block_list.orig_text:
クスクス、
見てくださいあなた様。
木刀に私とあなた様の名前を刻印していただきましたわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I don't understand this museum, the strange pottery experience, or these weird sticks... I'd never choose this on my own.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ……
よく分からない博物館に、
よく分からない焼き物体験に、
よく分からない木の棒に……
一人じゃ絶対に選ばないわ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Even so, it's exhilarating during a school trip, isn't it? Maybe it's a kind of magic too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それでもテンション爆アゲなのが修学旅行だよね♪
もしかして
これも魔法かな～？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Maybe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
かもね。

text_block_list.name: Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: Alright, from here on, it's free time by groups. Enjoy yourselves while maintaining the honor of the Magical Academy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
じゃあここからは
班での自由行動だ。
ア魔学の名を汚さぬよう、
節度を守って楽しんでこい！

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Shall we go, my lord?
text_block_list.orig_text: ではまいりましょうかあなた様。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: That's right! Hidesai is in the same group as us and Kyaru! We settled it with a match, didn't we?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そーだよ！　
ヒデサイは
うちとキャルっちと同じ班だし♪
ちゃんと勝負で決めたっしょ？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Indeed... 'Onii-chan Battle! Yukata Table Tennis Showdown'... We lost...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ですねー……
『お兄ちゃん争奪！　
浴衣卓球対決』……
私たち負けちゃいました～……

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Hmph... that duel was unfair! I was distracted by the yukata that fluttered open... In other words, the cause of our defeat was these voluptuous breasts! A modest chest like Kyaru's would have an advantage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん……
あの対決は不公平ですわ！
浴衣がはだけたせいで気を取られ……
つまり
敗因はこのたわわな胸！
キャルさんのような貧しいお胸の方が有利ですわ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: W-Who are you calling a modest chest!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だ、
誰が貧しいお胸よ！！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: Eriko-san, as one who aspires to be a samurai, I shall gracefully accept defeat. It is regrettable that I cannot remain by the Shogun's side.
text_block_list.orig_text:
エリコさん、
武士たる者、
潔く負けを認めまショウ。
ショーグンのお側にいられないのは
無念デスが
仕方ありまセーン。

text_block_list.name: Eriko
text_block_list.text: Hmph... I am not a samurai, but very well, I understand. Please allow me, for a short while, to part from your side. Later, let us share our respective memories until morning... Tehehe
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふん……
武士ではありませんがわかりましたわ。
あなた様、
少しの間だけ離れるエリコをお許しください。
後ほどそれぞれの思い出を朝まで語らいましょう……
クスクスクス。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Then let's go, too! Kyaru-chi, is there somewhere you'd like to visit?
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあうちらも行こっか♪
キャルっち
行きたいとこあるー？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Actually, Pecorine told me about this amazing mochi shop. Shall we go there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は
ペコリーヌに絶品のお団子屋さん教えてもらったのよね。
そこ行ってみない？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: What's this? It's surprisingly good! Another 100 pieces won't hurt♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにこれ、
ヤバうますぎてわろ～♪
あと100本はヨユーだし♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: You're going to gain weight, Supermodel! But honestly, it's irresistible. Maybe I should tell Eriko and the others about it too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
太るわよ、
このスーパーモデルが！
でも確かに止まらないわー
エリコやクラスのみんなにも教えてやろうかしら。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
What's with that look?
Is there something on my face?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なによあんた、
ニヤニヤこっち見て。
あたしの顔に何かついてる？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What's that about? I don't get it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
は……
はあ？　
なによそれ。
わけわかんないわ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Nah, I get it, Hidesai♪ Actually, I'm a bit touched right now. Kyaru-chi thinks about our class and stuff, it's like... heartwarming and stuff, you know?♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
わかるよヒデサイ♪　
てかうち今、
かるくカンドーちう。
キャルっちがクラスのみんなのこと思ってるとか、
エモエモのエモなんだけど……♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
W-What are you getting all emotional about?
I'm not usually like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そのくらいのことで感動されるって、
普段のあたしはなんなのよ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
...But yeah, I guess?
I don't dislike everyone in our class.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でもま、
確かに？
クラスのみんなのこと、
別に
嫌いじゃないわ。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Ugh! You damn four-eyes!! Making fun of me with your dough-like face! You're asking for it, cannibalism~! *smirk*
text_block_list.orig_text:
ケッ！　
クソメガネ！！
団子みたいな顔しやがって共食いか～！？
へっへっへっ！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
I take it back...!!!
I'm going to kill that guy for sure!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
前言撤回……！！
あいつだけはぶっ殺すわ！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, that kid is still irritated, huh~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
なんかあの子だけ
まだトガってるよねー♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, there's always one of those in every class, right? They can only express themselves by making a fuss like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ったく、
クラスに一人はいんのよねー
あーやって悪態つくことでしか自分を表現できない不器用なやつが。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Because of their attitude, they get avoided by everyone, and they end up wandering around alone during the school trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーいう態度だから
周りからも避けられて、
修学旅行も一人で回る羽目になっちゃうのよ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...If only there was at least one person who saw them and could be the catalyst for change... It's so troublesome.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ちゃんと見てくれてる人が一人でもいれば、
変わるきっかけになるのにね……
ほんと
めんどくさいわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...What's with you, Suzuna?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なによスズナ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Mm~♪ You're talking like you're talking about yourself~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～ん♪　
なんか
自分のことみたいに話すなあ～って♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: T-That's not true...!! ...I don't want to talk about that guy anymore! Let's look around for souvenirs!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなことないわよ……！！
……もうあんなやつのことはいいわ！
お土産でも見て回りましょ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Wow~♪ This hairpin would look great on Misaki-chi! Should we all get matching ones with Chan-Io?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁ～♪　
このかんざし
ミサキっちに似合うっぽー♪
ちゃんイオと３人おそろで買っちゃおーかなー♪

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: This teacup is so cute. I want to buy souvenirs for everyone at the Gourmet... Wait, there's someone who won't be satisfied with just this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このお茶碗かわいいわね。
【美食殿】のみんなにお土産に……
って、
一人だけこれじゃ満足できないのがいるわね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
That's a good idea!...
Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいじゃないそれ！
……ん？

text_block_list.text: Hey, let it go, old man!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
離せよおっさん！！

text_block_list.text: You won't escape, you delinquent!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 逃がすかこの不良めが！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Wait, could it be... this voice?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
もしかしてこの声って……！？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
"Shooting Range"... that's the shop.
Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『射的場』……
あの店からね。
行くわよ！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate me,
you cheater!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
舐めた真似してくれんじゃねぇか！
このイカサマ野郎！！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: I didn't cheat! You just got distracted! I won it fair and square with my skills! Now hand it over!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イカサマなんてしてねえ！！
おっさんがよそ見してただけだろ！？
俺は実力でそのこけし取ったんだ！　
さっさとよこせ！！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Damn it! You kept looking, but your archery skills are total garbage! You tried dozens of times and never hit anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ケッ！　
ずっと見てたが
テメーの弓の腕はてんでダメだ！
何十回挑戦しても、
かすりもしてなかったじゃねーか！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: And you expect me to believe that you succeeded just by chance while I wasn't looking?! There's no way you could've gotten that kokeshi doll!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それがたまたま俺がよそ見してたときに限って成功したって？
そんなことあるか！！　
お前にあのこけしが取れるわけねえ！！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Hey kid... That school uniform, you're from Magic Academy, right? I know because you guys come here every year for your school trip.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいガキ……
その制服、
ア魔学の生徒だろ？
毎年修学旅行で来てるから知ってる。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: You probably used your magic to cheat and get that prize to fall, right? Your little trick has been exposed, you scoundrel!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうせ魔法の力を使ってイカサマしたんだろ！？
ネタはあがってんだこの野郎！！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Let me say this...!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 言わせておけばこの……！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wait, You, what are you doing?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとあんた、
何やってんのよ！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Geh! Shitty-four-Eyes!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲゲ！　
クソメガネッ！？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: I... I'm not doing anything!! I didn't cheat!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な……
なにもしてねーよ！！
俺はイカサマなんてしてねえ！！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Damn four-eyes... You're not planning to say I cheated to win the prize too, are you!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
クソメガネ……
てめえも俺がズルして
景品取ったって言うつもりかよ！？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it! None of you ever listen to what I'm saying...!!
Damn it!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……クソッ！　
どいつもこいつも人の話も聞かねえで……！！
畜生ッ！！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Wait, where are you going~!?
Kyaru-chi, I'm going after you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ちょ、
どこ行くの～！？
キャルっち、
うち追いかけてくるね！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Tch! Did he run away... Misses, are you his friends? ...Nah, that can't be. Good, honest girls like you with a guy like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
チッ！　
逃げやがったか……
嬢ちゃん方、
あいつの友達か？
……いや、
そんなわけないよな。
嬢ちゃん方みてえな真面目な子があんな奴と。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Is there any evidence that he cheated?
text_block_list.orig_text: あいつがイカサマやったって証拠はあるのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Miss, aren't you also a student from The Magic Academy? If that's the case, using magic to easily drop those prizes from the shelf should be a piece of cake, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
嬢ちゃんも
ア魔学の生徒だろ？
だったら魔法の力で、
あの棚の景品を落とすことなんて、
朝飯前じゃねえのか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well, if it were me, I could probably do it easily. But it's impossible for that guy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そりゃあたしなら簡単にできるでしょうね。
でも
あいつには無理。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: That's because he can't use magic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だってあいつ
魔法使えないから。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No, that can't be...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあ！？
いや、
んなわけ……！！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Just so you know, that guy can't even light a fire with a igniter. He's so pathetically incapable of even basic magic that there's no way he could manipulate the shelf's prizes with magic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言っとくけどあいつ、
着火剤に火を着けることもできないのよ？
初歩の魔法もできないレベルの残念過ぎるあのバカが、
棚の景品を動かす魔法なんてひっくり返っても無理ね。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...!
I-Is that so?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
そ……
そうなのか？

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Well, but... he's a delinquent, right?
...It's his fault for acting in a way that makes people suspicious!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや、
でも……
あいつ不良だろ？
……人に疑われるようなナリしてんのが悪いんだ！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...What did you say?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……なんですって？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Kyaru-chi~! I brought him with me♪
And you're so late, whats up~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルっち～！　
連れてきたよ♪
てかキミ
遅すぎてわろ～♪

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Ouch! Let me go, Suzuna-cha...
text_block_list.orig_text:
痛
えっ！　
離してくれよスズナちゃ……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Don't be ridiculous!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ふざけんじゃないわよ！！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Kyaru-chi is angry...?
What happened, Hidesai...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
キャルっち
おにギレちう……？
なにがあったのヒデサイ……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Accusing someone of being a delinquent without any evidence, labeling them as such, and hurting them based on appearance...
text_block_list.orig_text:
証拠もないのに、
不良だってレッテル貼って、
見た目で疑って傷つけて……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: It's because there are adults like you that I am irritated...!! All adults are no good, and I don't want to look back...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたみたいな大人がいるからグレちゃうのよ……！！
大人なんてロクなもんじゃないって、
後ろを向きたくなんのよ……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...I also judge my homeroom teacher based on appearance as berserker, so I can't say anything... But don't judge based on looks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あたしも
担任を見た目でバーサーカー認定してるし、
人のことは言えないけど……
見た目で判断しないで。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...You said it, didn't you? That a diligent girl like me can't be friends with someone like that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あんた、
言ったわよね。
嬢ちゃんみたいな真面目な子が、
あんなやつの友達なわけないって。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I'll say it! I'm not a diligent girl! And that-bastard that-really-pisses-me-off,-that-make-me-want-kill-him-someday...
text_block_list.orig_text:
言ってやるわ！　
あたしは真面目なんかじゃないし！
それに
あのクソ野郎は、
めちゃくちゃムカつくし、
いつか絶対ぶっ殺すけど……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Are friends from our school!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ……おんなじ学園の友達よ！！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: ...tch... Shitty-four-eyes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ううっ……
クソメガネ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Wait, why are you here?!! Don't just come back like nothing happened!! Wait, what are you even listen here? I'll kill you!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って
なんであんたいんのよ！！？
しれっと帰って来てんじゃないわよ！！
てかなに聞いてんのよ、
殺すわよ！！？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, of course.
I swear in the name of my Grandma.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ、
もちろんだ。
ばあちゃんに誓ってやってねえ。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry. I said terrible things without any evidence. It's true... Please forgive me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……すまなかった。
なんの証拠もなくひどいことを。
この通りだ……
許してくれ。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ...That's right. If you want, you can take that kokeshi doll too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだ。
あのこけしも、
良かったら持ってってくれ。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: ...I don't need it. Every time I see that kokeshi doll, it just brings back today's unpleasant memories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いらねえよ。
そのこけし見るたびに、
今日の嫌な思い出がよみがえっちまうしな。

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Sorry.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうか、
すまねえ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what is it,
Hidesai? Yeah, yeah....Yeah! ...Okay, got it♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
なにヒデサイ？
うん、
うん……
うん、
わかった♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Uncle, here's the money!
I'm going to give it a try once♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
おじさーん、
はいお金！
うち一回挑戦するね♪

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, okay, then here are the arrows.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
あ、
ああ、
じゃあこれ矢だ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll aim carefully~... There we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし、
よく狙って～～
……
よっと！

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: What! You managed to knock it down with one arrow!! That definitely didn't look like magic...! No doubt, this kokeshi belongs to the girl!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なっ！　
一矢目で落としやがった！！
今のは
どう見ても魔法使ってねえ……！
文句なくこのこけしは
嬢ちゃんのもんだ！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: You're... amazing, Suzuna-chan. Wait, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
す……
すげえぜスズナちゃん。
って、
え？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Yes, here I'm giving you the kokeshi.♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
こけしあげる♪

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Why? What's going on...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
なんで、
どういうことだ……？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph, I see you're quick on your feet. Come on, accept it gratefully.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふん、
なるほど
機転が利くじゃない。
ほら、
ありがたく貰っときなさいよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Now it's not a bad memory anymore, right?
After all, it's a kokeshi given by a supermodel.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これでもう嫌な思い出じゃなくなったでしょ？
なんたって
スーパーモデルから貰ったこけしなんだから。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text:
...!! Thank you, Suzuna-chan...!!
Thank you, {0}...!! And... thank you... ...Shitty-four-eyes...I mean
text_block_list.orig_text:
……！！　
ありがとうスズナちゃん……！！
{0}もありがとう……！！
それに……
ありがとう……
クソメガ……

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: Thank you....Kyaru.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう……
キャル。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Huh? you can't just call someone that you acknowledged by their first name all of a sudden, it's ridiculous. And why are you suddenly on the side of acknowledgment in the first place?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
認めた相手に急に名前呼び、
とか
しょうもないのよ。
そもそも
なんであんたが認める側に立ってんのよ。

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: ...Tch! You're not cute, you Kuso-four-eyes!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ケッ！　
かわいくねークソメガネだぜ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Kyahaha♪ It's a happy ending, isn't it♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃはは♪
めでたしめでたし、
だね♪

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: But can I ask one last thing~? That kokeshi is definitely cute, but why did you want it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
最後に一つ
聞いてい～い？
そのこけし、
確かにもにカワちゃんなんだけど、
なんでそれ欲しかったの？

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text:
...It's a souvenir.
I thought my grandma would be happy with it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……土産だよ。
ばあちゃん、
喜んでくれると思ってよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Even though he looks like this, He is a Grandma's boy in heart, what a nice guy! !
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな見た目でおばあちゃん子って
ただのいいやつか！！

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Student
text_block_list.text: No, don't judge people by their appearance!!
text_block_list.orig_text: いや人を見た目で判断してんじゃねえ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The sun sets over Oedo Yokocho. With the school trip coming to an end, Kyaru and her friends return to the magic academy with happy memories in their hearts.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーエド横丁に夕日が沈む。
修学旅行も終わり、キャルたちは楽しい思い出を胸に、
魔法学園へと帰るのであった。
